summary: PDF-report fix VERIFIED. Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_report.py: ALL 14 TESTS PASS (14/14). The reportlab ValueError on Paragraph is fully resolved by emitting plain-text 'Allegato pagina N' inside the PDF while keeping the clickable anchor in the HTML preview after close. Verified: (1) POST /api/blocks/{id}/close returns 200 with download_url to a PDF; (2) GET /api/public/download/{token} serves application/pdf, magic bytes '%PDF', PdfReader counts pages >= 1 + numero_allegati; (3) report-html contains anchor Allegato pagina N AFTER close, plain text BEFORE close; (4) Bonifico wording correct for all 3 directions (parent1_to_parent2 → 'Bonifico effettuato da Marco'; parent2_to_parent1 → 'Rimborso a carico di Elena'; none → 'Nessun bonifico da effettuare'); (5) resend-email re-creates a PDF (not ZIP). Full regression run (98 tests): 90 passed, 1 skipped, 8 failed. Of the 8 failures: 6 are OBSOLETE pre-existing tests that assert the OLD ZIP/'Sì'-'No' contract (test_closure_attachments.py, test_download_link_fix.py, test_report_html.py) — they contradict the intentional ZIP→PDF migration and must be deleted or rewritten by main agent. The remaining 2 (test_security_fixes.py TestRateLimitExportEmail / TestRateLimitIsolation) fail with Cloudflare 502 on POST /api/export/year/2027/email — pre-existing flakiness (backend logs show no crash, only Resend 422 'undeliverable_recipient' which is non-fatal; the 502 is an edge/proxy gateway timeout, not caused by this iteration's fix).

minor.issue: Returns Cloudflare 502 bad gateway intermittently (pre-existing). Likely upstream timeout: endpoint renders 12 monthly PDFs sequentially + Resend call. Backend logs show no crash — proxy times out before response. Causes test_security_fixes::TestRateLimitExportEmail + TestRateLimitIsolation to fail on first call. Mitigate by: (a) running PDF generation concurrently, or (b) returning 202 + background task.

Backend doesn't crash (no stack trace in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log, only Resend 422 'undeliverable_recipient' which is handled); the 502 is a Cloudflare gateway timeout. Consider making the handler non-blocking or splitting PDF generation into a background task so the HTTP response returns within the proxy's timeout window.

rca_of_issue: Previous iteration (iter_9) RCA was correct: reportlab Paragraph raises ValueError because reportlab treats '#...' as an internal named-destination lookup, and no destination was registered with that literal name. The fix (iteration_10) emits the label as a plain-text Paragraph inside the PDF — satisfying the fallback review requirement 'at least the string Allegato pagina N present'. The clickable anchor is still produced in the HTML preview after close (last_download_url is saved on the block document and read by report-html template). Confirmed via: PdfReader.extract_text() → 'Allegato pagina N' on first/second page; HTML preview contains Allegato pagina N only after close. End-to-end UX preserved: user opens HTML in browser, clicks the anchor, the PDF opens at the right page via the PDF viewer's native #page=N fragment.
